subject: Evidence lockdown & risk log — Q4 renewal check-in
messages:
From: Finance Ops <finance@acmeinc.com>

Cc: Samantha Roy <samantha@brightwave.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q4 renewal: evidence list + target commit date

Hi Soojin,

We're finalizing our internal renewal package for the Acme enterprise agreement and need a consolidated set of evidence and a confirmed commit date to pass to procurement. Can you confirm the following by EOD 10/20?

- Usage summary (tokens, embeddings) for the last 12 months
- Security evidence: SOC2 scope note + where to access the audit artifact
- Billing/seat changes and any upcoming discounts or credits applied to our account
- Your suggested target commit date (we're aiming to close before 11/01)

If possible, attach a short one-page summary and the raw CSV for finance. Procurement has flagged churn risk and wants a short mitigation plan if there are usage dips.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

— Alex (Finance Ops)
Acme Inc.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Finance Ops <finance@acmeinc.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Q4 renewal: evidence list + target commit date

Hi Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. High-level answers up front:

- Usage summary: will attach compressed PDF + CSV (monthly granularity) — includes tokens, embeddings, and active seat counts.
- Security: SOC 2 report (scope: production + customer data path) is available via our compliance portal; I'll include a direct link and an export for procurement.
- Billing/credits: No automatic credits scheduled; there is a one-time onboarding credit from Q1 which we've applied. If you need a commercial adjustment for term, we can route to Sales Ops.
- Target commit: proposing 10/28 as an internal commit (gives both teams time for procurement review ahead of 11/01).

Attachments: acme_usage_trends_q3.pdf, commit_evidence_table.xlsx — see Drive link in the bottom of this thread.

Naomi — can you add a 2–3 bullet mitigation plan focused on usage dips? Marissa — can you confirm whether any billing evidence requires finance ops to sign a separate form?

If Alex wants a call, I'm available 10/16 between 9–11 PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Owner, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:32:00 -07:00

On Wed, Oct 14, 2026 at 10:05 AM Soojin Lee wrote:
> Naomi — can you add a 2–3 bullet mitigation plan focused on usage dips? Marissa — can you confirm whether any billing evidence requires finance ops to sign a separate form?

Quick draft mitigation bullets for the evidence one-pager (feel free to edit):

1) Proactive prefix caching: we can enable a 30-day prefix/KV cache for their highest-volume routes to smooth short-term token spikes and reduce perceived latency during low-usage periods. Expected cost change: negligible; improves continuity.

2) Opportunistic burst capacity: reserve two days of burst capacity for month-end heavy runs (applies if they run batch inference jobs). Requires a 7-day notice; we can include a simple calendar action in the mutual action plan.

3) Usage alerting + auto-escalation: configure threshold alerts (20% QoQ drop) to trigger an ops review and a short remediation playbook (trial credits + short-term model routing to maintain latency SLOs).

Billing form: Marissa, suggest we attach the standard billing confirmation PDF. If Acme requests invoice-level line items beyond our standard export, finance will need a signed data request.

— Naomi
Director, Renewal Ops

Looking forward to closing this for 11/01.

Best,
Soojin Lee
